{
  "relevant_files": [
    "sketch/sketch7/context/context.go",
    "sketch/sketch7/context/repo.go",
    "sketch/sketch7/context/sections.go",
    "sketch/sketch7/context/context_test.go"
  ],
  "findings": [
    "Functionality: The context system builds an inference `Payload` containing `Sections` (system prompts) and `Messages` (conversation history). `Builder.Build` (context.go:52) merges static section plans with a trimmed transcript of `SessionHistory`.",
    "Functionality: `BuildSections` (sections.go:15) dynamically generates system sections based on `agentDef.Context.Projections`, injecting runtime state for interaction mode, cognitive state, workflow progress, and repository context.",
    "Functionality: Message history is trimmed by count (default 12) using `trimMessages` (context.go:99), which groups tool calls/results into blocks, preserves the latest user message as an anchor, and handles edge-case tool exchanges.",
    "Functionality: Repository context (`repo.go`) scans the filesystem for file counts, marker files, and top-level entries, supplemented by `git status`. Results are cached in `RepoContextCache` and refreshed every N turns.",
    "Issue: Global Mutable State - `sections.go:13` declares `var defaultRepoCache RepoContextCache`, making the context builder non-reentrant and causing potential cross-session interference in concurrent environments.",
    "Issue: Hardcoded Workflow Logic - `sections.go:106` and `sections.go:122` hardcode workflow states (`intake`, `repo_orientation`, etc.) and required checkpoints, tightly coupling the context builder to a specific workflow definition.",
    "Issue: Count-Based vs Token-Based Truncation - `trimMessages` limits context by message count (context.go:56-60), not token count. This can either truncate useful context prematurely or exceed LLM token limits depending on message length.",
    "Issue: Inefficient/Unsafe Repo Scanning - `scanRepo` (repo.go:121) uses `filepath.Walk` without respecting `.gitignore`, and `runGit` (repo.go:235) executes raw git commands which can hang or pose security risks in containerized/multi-tenant setups.",
    "Issue: Fragile Message Blocking - `expandLeadingToolExchange` (context.go:190) performs a backward linear search through all blocks to match `CallID`, creating O(N*M) complexity and brittle edge-case handling.",
    "Issue: Dead/Unused Code - `crypto/sha1` is imported and `HashContent` is exported (context.go:237) but never used in the build pipeline. The `workflow` parameter in `Builder.Build` is explicitly ignored (context.go:53)."
  ],
  "unknowns": [
    "How the constructed `Payload` is serialized and consumed by downstream providers/runners.",
    "The configuration source and validation logic for `agentDef.Context.Projections`.",
    "Whether `HashContent` is intended for future caching/deduplication or is leftover experimental code.",
    "How `WorkflowHistory` is expected to be utilized, given it is currently ignored in `Builder.Build`."
  ],
  "enough_context": true
}
